status: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER BUILD - every numeric block below is a clearly-labelled synthetic value (typical NHS pattern) so the full pipeline runs end-to-end. Replace each block's value(s) with the real figure from the source named in that block, set granularity to 'provider' or 'national', and delete the SYNTHETIC prefix from its source.
